query: What are three fragrance-free moisturizers for sensitive skin available in the US? Include sources.

raw_runs.query: What are three fragrance-free moisturizers for sensitive skin available in the US? Include sources.
raw_runs.raw:
Three fragrance-free moisturizers for sensitive skin that are available in the U.S.:

- Vanicream Daily Facial Moisturizer — Lightweight, non-comedogenic, and formulated specifically for sensitive skin. It contains hyaluronic acid, squalane, and five ceramides, with no fragrance, botanical extracts, or essential oils. ([vanicream.com](https://www.vanicream.com/product/vanicream-daily-facial-moisturizer?utm_source=openai))
- CeraVe Moisturizing Cream — A richer face-and-body option for dry to very dry sensitive skin. It’s fragrance-free and contains ceramides, hyaluronic acid, petrolatum, and glycerin to support the skin barrier and retain moisture. ([africa.cerave.com](https://africa.cerave.com/en/sitecore/content/loreal/brandsites/cerave/americas/us/home/skincare/moisturizers/moisturizing-cream?utm_source=openai))
- Aveeno Calm + Restore Oat Gel Moisturizer — A lightweight facial gel designed for sensitive skin. It uses prebiotic oat and feverfew and is fragrance-free; a good option if you prefer a lighter texture. ([aveeno.com](https://www.aveeno.com/products/calm-restore-oat-gel-moisturizer-sensitive-skin?utm_source=openai))

For very reactive skin, Vanicream is particularly straightforward because it also avoids essential oils and botanical extracts. For very dry skin, CeraVe's richer cream may be preferable.
